CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.machine_result : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.run (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.totalTime xp yp xs ys er)
        (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar) =
      CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
    CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.Halted (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) ∧
      (∀ k < CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.totalTime xp yp xs ys er,
          ¬CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.Halted
              (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.run k
                (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar))) ∧
        CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.retained (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
            EncodedDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
          CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.outputTape (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
            MarkedZeroPadding.marked (MarkedZeroPadding.bits (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp yp er))
CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final_cells : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.cells (CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
    EncodedDyadicAddition.cells (EncodedDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) +
        (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp yp er).length +
      2

ExtractedDyadicOutput.machine_result : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  ExtractedDyadicOutput.run (ExtractedDyadicOutput.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)
        (ExtractedDyadicOutput.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar) =
      ExtractedDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
    ExtractedDyadicOutput.Halted (ExtractedDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) ∧
      (∀ k < ExtractedDyadicOutput.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar,
          ¬ExtractedDyadicOutput.Halted
              (ExtractedDyadicOutput.run k (ExtractedDyadicOutput.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar))) ∧
        ExtractedDyadicOutput.retained (ExtractedDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
            CopiedExponentDyadicAddition.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
          ExtractedDyadicOutput.outputTape (ExtractedDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
            MarkedZeroPadding.marked
              (MarkedZeroPadding.bits (List.map Prod.snd (ExtractedDyadicOutput.sumRows xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)))
ExtractedDyadicOutput.numerator_encoding : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  let dx := EncodedDyadicAddition.leftShift xp yp er;
  let dy := EncodedDyadicAddition.rightShift xp yp er;
  let px := MarkedZeroPadding.padded dx xs;
  let py := MarkedZeroPadding.padded dy ys;
  let p := SignedWordAlignment.aligned px sx py sy;
  let low := SequentialBitAddition.scan p (SequentialBitAddition.zeroCarry (MarkedPairLayout.clearScratch ar));
  let lastLow := SequentialBitAddition.sumBit sx sy low.registers.carry;
  let sign := SequentialBitAddition.sumBit sx sy (SequentialBitAddition.carryBit sx sy low.registers.carry);
  List.map Prod.snd (ExtractedDyadicOutput.sumRows xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) = low.output ++ [lastLow, sign] ∧
    CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
        { numerator := SequentialBitAddition.signedValue (low.output ++ [lastLow]) sign,
          fractionalBits := CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp yp er) } =
      ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue xs sx) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value xp +
        ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue ys sy) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp

MarkedSignedWordSplit.split_result : ∀ (low : List Bool) (sign held oldSign : Bool),
  MarkedSignedWordSplit.run (MarkedSignedWordSplit.totalTime low)
        (MarkedSignedWordSplit.initial low sign held oldSign) =
      MarkedSignedWordSplit.final low sign ∧
    (MarkedSignedWordSplit.final low sign).phase = MarkedSignedWordSplit.Phase.halt ∧
      ∀ k < MarkedSignedWordSplit.totalTime low,
        (MarkedSignedWordSplit.run k (MarkedSignedWordSplit.initial low sign held oldSign)).phase ≠
          MarkedSignedWordSplit.Phase.halt
MarkedSignedWordSplit.split_layout : ∀ (low : List Bool) (sign held oldSign : Bool),
  let s :=
    MarkedSignedWordSplit.run (MarkedSignedWordSplit.totalTime low)
      (MarkedSignedWordSplit.initial low sign held oldSign);
  s.input = MarkedZeroPadding.marked (MarkedZeroPadding.bits (low ++ [sign])) ∧
    s.output = MarkedZeroPadding.marked (MarkedZeroPadding.bits low) ∧ s.sign = sign ∧ s.held = false

ReusableDyadicOutput.machine_result : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy bl br : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers) (held oldSign : Bool),
  ReusableDyadicOutput.run (ReusableDyadicOutput.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)
        (ReusableDyadicOutput.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign) =
      ReusableDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
    ReusableDyadicOutput.Halted (ReusableDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) ∧
      (∀ k < ReusableDyadicOutput.totalTime xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar,
          ¬ReusableDyadicOutput.Halted
              (ReusableDyadicOutput.run k (ReusableDyadicOutput.initial xp yp xs ys sx sy bl br er ar held oldSign))) ∧
        ReusableDyadicOutput.retained (ReusableDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
          ExtractedDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar
ReusableDyadicOutput.output_representation : ∀ (xp yp xs ys : List Bool) (sx sy : Bool)
  (er ar : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  ReusableDyadicOutput.outputTape (ReusableDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
      MarkedZeroPadding.marked (MarkedZeroPadding.bits (ReusableDyadicOutput.lowWord xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)) ∧
    ReusableDyadicOutput.outputSign (ReusableDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
        ReusableDyadicOutput.signBit xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar ∧
      ReusableDyadicOutput.exponentTape (ReusableDyadicOutput.final xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar) =
          MarkedZeroPadding.marked (MarkedZeroPadding.bits (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp yp er)) ∧
        CurrentMain.Current1094Row1DyadicReference.value
            {
              numerator :=
                SequentialBitAddition.signedValue (ReusableDyadicOutput.lowWord xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar)
                  (ReusableDyadicOutput.signBit xp yp xs ys sx sy er ar),
              fractionalBits := CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value (EncodedDyadicAddition.commonWord xp yp er) } =
          ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue xs sx) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value xp +
            ↑(SequentialBitAddition.signedValue ys sy) / 2 ^ CurrentMain.PairedBitXorScan.value yp

acceptance_note: Exact source-bound acceptance. All four roots are diagnostic-free. All original failures and repairs are preserved separately.
limits: Physically encoded inputs, finite registers, independent workspaces and fresh output tapes are supplied; no initial encoding or allocation is executed.
Actual exponent copy, numerator extraction and delayed-bit sign split are charged; the fourteen-tape endpoint is reusable in its specified alphabet.
The inherited exponent-gap unary production remains numeric-magnitude-dependent. No root-uniform C(n+w), global precision or full multiplication cost is supplied.
The result is not physically installed into an occupied caller slot. Added finite scratch is cleared or overwritten, not restored arbitrarily.

Separate accepted same-width signed-half and fixed-Q value-link components now supply a parity-qualified physical half. Fixed-grid initialization, complete SCALE/caller composition and uniform charge remain separate.
